fact: On 22 June 2026 SNDI's deputy director general listed applications SNDI developed for government, including SIGFIP, SIGOMAP v1, the CEPICI one-stop shop system, GUPC and the roadmap and decision-tracking platforms, and said SNDI deploys and runs a national satellite network.
title: Digitalisation des services publics en Côte d'Ivoire : les applications-métiers développées par la SNDI
